prepSteps.title: Create a read-only Artifactory token
prepSteps.instruction: In JFrog, create a user or identity token with Entro's read scopes and store the token in the operator vault.
prepSteps.evidence: Artifactory shows the Entro token (value stored outside the session)

typedActions.preview: Platform has no dry-run for this change; disclosed as no-preview.
typedActions.mutation: jf access-token-create --groups <read-group> --expiry 0 (or identity token per Entro scopes); operator stores the token in the vault
typedActions.expectedChange: Artifactory shows the Entro token (value stored outside the session)
typedActions.verification: jf rt ping ; jf config show
typedActions.rollbackOrImpact: Revoke the access token created this run from JFrog User Management
